Bought this as the dryer I have doesn't have a stand made by the manufacturer. I wasn't sure it would work for me, but after receiving and assembling this stand and putting the dryer on top I was very impressed. It is made from heavy steel, and bolts together solid. After 6 months of use, it hasn't flexed, bent, or loosened at all. The storage underneath is fantastic and was a perfect fit for where my vent is located. Very highly recommended for front load washers and dryers up to 7.4cu

Heavy duty. A little time consuming to assemble. Definitely requires dexterity. Once together though it is a solid great open riser for washer and dryer. Definitely worth the price and I would buy again

For the price this stand is fantastic. I was given a similar one and bought this to match. Easy to assemble and nice to have storage under the machine. My baskets and laundry items (such as detergent) fit underneath. It is so nice not to the to unload the machines at floor level.
